name: 🛡️ Secure AI SaaS Helpdesk — Prompt Injection Defense & PII Redaction (SoterAI + Groq)

parameters.content:
## AI SaaS Helpdesk Chatbot — Prompt Injection Protection & PII Redaction (SoterAI + Groq)

### How it works

This workflow contains no nodes, so it does not currently perform any automated actions. There are no triggers, processing steps, or outputs to group on the canvas.

### Setup steps

- Add a trigger node to define how the workflow should start.
- Add processing and output nodes as needed, then configure any required credentials.

### Customization

Build out the workflow by adding nodes for the desired data source, transformation logic, and destination.

parameters.allowedTopics: billing, account number subscriptions, invoices, sso login, api errors, csv export, bug reports, feature requests, account help
parameters.systemPromptContext: You are AcmeCloud SaaS support for billing, login, API, exports, bug reports and account help.

parameters.jsCode: const g=$input.first().json;const c=$('On Chat Message Received').first().json;return [{json:{event:'soter_block',sessionId:c.sessionId??null,chatInput:c.chatInput??null,verdictCode:g.verdictCode??null,riskLevel:g.riskLevel??null,riskScore:g.riskScore??null,timestamp:new Date().toISOString()}}];

parameters.message: =Blocked by SoterAI Security. Your message looked like a prompt-injection or policy violation, so it was stopped before the AI agent. Verdict: {{ $json.verdictCode ?? "CONTENT_BLOCKED" }} | Risk: {{ $json.riskLevel ?? "n/a" }}. Please rephrase your support question.

parameters.jsCode: const chat=$('On Chat Message Received').first().json;const guard=$('Guard Input for Threats').first().json;const pii=$input.first().json;const clean=pii.safeText??pii.redactedText??pii.outputText??guard.safeText??chat.chatInput;return [{json:{sessionId:chat.sessionId??null,chatInput:chat.chatInput??'',safeText:guard.safeText??chat.chatInput??'',cleanText:clean,verdictCode:guard.verdictCode??null,riskLevel:guard.riskLevel??null}}];
